title: DSU: Offline Connectivity Queries
statement:
You are given N nodes and M edges added one by one. After all edges are added, answer Q offline queries of the form: "Are nodes u and v in the same connected component?"

All Q queries are given after all M edges. Process them using DSU (Disjoint Set Union) built from all M edges.

Print "YES" if u and v are connected, otherwise "NO".
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and M.
The next M lines each contain two integers u and v (an edge).
The next line contains Q.
The next Q lines each contain two integers u and v.

examples.explanation: All 5 nodes end up in one component after 4 edges.

starterCode.python:
import sys
input = sys.stdin.readline

n, m = map(int, input().split())
parent = list(range(n + 1))
rank = [0] * (n + 1)

def find(x):
    while parent[x] != x:
        parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
        x = parent[x]
    return x

def union(a, b):
    ra, rb = find(a), find(b)
    if ra == rb: return
    if rank[ra] < rank[rb]: ra, rb = rb, ra
    parent[rb] = ra
    if rank[ra] == rank[rb]: rank[ra] += 1

for _ in range(m):
    u, v = map(int, input().split())
    union(u, v)

q = int(input())
for _ in range(q):
    u, v = map(int, input().split())
    print("YES" if find(u) == find(v) else "NO")
